objective: SAXPY y[i] = a*x[i] + y[i] over fp32 must match the CPU reference within atol 1e-6 on the typical, zero_block and tail data sets, at a device time the bench actually measured.

criteria.statement: geomean speedup over the recorded baseline across 1 matrix cell(s) (each cell is the geomean of its input group(s), so one group's regression moves the cell; 3 group(s) in the matrix)
every matrix cell matches the reference on every input group, on two consecutive passes
